title: PowerShell Core and Professional Practice Assessment

recommended_settings.attempts: Follow CodeLeaf exam policy; this blueprint does not change live attempt limits.

assessment_type: Mixed single-choice knowledge checks plus a human-reviewed portfolio capstone.
outcomes: Write readable PowerShell expressions, use the pipeline, control flow and reusable functions.
Process files and structured data with validation and safe output handling.
Integrate APIs, modules, remoting and platform-aware workflows.
Test and troubleshoot automation, document version support, and apply security-first design.
Review automation for maintainability, configuration drift, CI/CD readiness and release safety.

topic_distribution.topic: Fundamentals, command discovery, navigation and pipeline
Language, data, control flow and scripts
Functions, diagnostics, files and system administration
Testing, design, configuration, deployment and professional practice

human_review_requirements: Capstone rubric score and portfolio evidence
Pester and static-analysis evidence where applicable
remediation: Review topic-level feedback and retry the linked lesson knowledge checks; exam success does not replace technical review of production scripts.
